text: Artificial intelligence is transforming our world, but it also raises important ethical questions. One major concern is bias, as AI systems can learn from historical data that contains unfair prejudices. This makes fairness crucial; developers must ensure algorithms treat all people equally. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often collects vast amounts of personal information, so data protection is essential. Transparency also matters—people should understand how decisions are made, especially in areas like hiring or lending. Finally, responsible AI development means considering the broader impact on society, not just technical performance. By focusing on these principles, we can build technology that is both powerful and ethical.
